original_test_intent: Verify the requested chassis, board and product FRU fields are readable, correct and equivalent between the BMC WebUI, IPMI FRU record and approved platform identity.
original_method: Bind the SUT/BMC and FRU locator, capture the UI, execute protected read-only `ipmitool fru print`, parse all named fields and compare normalized values with the approved record.
manual_activity: The owner supplies locator, expected values and normalization rules; an operator may capture UI-only data while automation performs the bounded FRU read and comparison.
required_inputs: Encoding, whitespace, date and optional-field rules
safety_requirements: Verify WebUI and IPMI target the same FRU
Stop on locator ambiguity or source disagreement
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Parse/check and normalize chassis, board and product areas
Produce a three-way comparison without writing FRU or deciding the verdict
engineer_actions: Supply the locator and approved FRU record

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Completely inapplicable: TEMP_MIDPLANE sensor data belongs to duplicate row 774 and does not read FRU areas.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected `ipmitool fru print` only after verifying the BMC and FRU locator; pair it with the UI capture and approved record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All named fields, WebUI-to-IPMI equivalence and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve raw/UI evidence and compare normalized fields in a chassis/board/product matrix with parse and checksum state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target binding, normalization and authoritative expected values.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every listed FRU field remains required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Optional fields and vendor formatting can differ without semantic mismatch; a wrong locator can attribute another device's identity.

project_override_considerations: The project may declare optional/blank fields or approved formatting equivalence, but must document each exception and may not write FRU data to force a match.
expected_evidence: Approved FRU record and normalization rules
Raw ipmitool fru print and parse/checksum state
Relevant preserved events and no-write audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1496 consistently defines FRU comparison; duplicate row 774 is isolated by variant and remains a midplane thermal case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Locator, expected record and normalization rules are finite package inputs; once supplied, read-only comparison is executable.

review_improvement: Removes midplane-sensor contamination and turns generic correctness into a complete, locator-bound UI/IPMI/oracle field comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source provides a finite field list and an explicit IPMI comparison, but not the authoritative values or normalization rules. Those are project artifacts, so the case is conditional rather than fully ready or permanently blocked.
